about: App Store frames. Store scenes (StoreScenesUITests) photographs each set's scenes in the App Store build on the review demo kitchen; scripts/store-frames/render.mjs puts each scene in its frame with the caption here. Every caption must stay true of the build it ships with (Guideline 2.3), and a siri phrase must be one of the app's App Shortcuts phrases (SpoonjoyAppIntents.swift). The first three shots of a set are the ones search results show. Every shot in a set shows a different scene with a different headline, and scripts/store-frames/distinct.mjs refuses two screenshots in one set that look the same. The iPhone Duo set's scenes are checked in under scenes_from: the Duo tour (duo-tour.yml, store_links) photographs them in each pose.
